liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bertha** (3 reviews): Reviewer finds the Bertha into Greatest Story opening excellent, with the show really picking up in the second set; Reviewer hears a brisk, high-energy Bertha, though the vocals sound a bit thin [19][22][24]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Reviewer says the drummers' well-judged timing lifts a breezy Greatest Story [22]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Reviewer cites Uncle John's Band as a fine example of Jerry's higher-level playing [22]
- **Playin** (1 review): Reviewer finds the Playin' into Uncle John's Band sequence especially sweet [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-05-21.167081.shure.sm57.kelley.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 156 min [1]
- **gd1982-05-21.149237.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 144 min [3]
- **gd82-05-21.sbd.gorinsky.5041.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 143 min; rated 4.15/5 by 13 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard quality stellar, unusually good for an early-80s show [18]
- **gd1982-05-21.sbd.fix.miller.96330.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 142 min; rated 4.08/5 by 12 [9]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes minor fluttering during Sugar Magnolia but no other serious flaws in the recording [26]
- **gd1982-05-21.163527.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 145 min [10]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says photos show an unusually wide display of tie-dye in the crowd at these Greek shows [20]
- Reviewer says they appear in a photograph in a Grateful Dead book taken at this show [20]
- Reviewer describes a short second set with plenty of jams, and a band that sounds happy to play [25]
- Reviewer says the following night of the run turned out even better than this one [19]
- Reviewer feels all three nights of the run had roughly equivalent performances [20]
- Reviewer says this night has less energy and a weaker setlist than the next night's show [24]
- Reviewer finds this early Bertha into Greatest Story looser than the tighter later-1980s versions [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-05-21.167081.shure.sm57.kelley.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Ken Kelley; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Ken Kelley's Master Audience Cassettes; Shure SM57 mics > JVC KD-2 w/Super ANRS (Maxell XLII-S90) [1]. Also: Bob Wagner's Nakamichi 700 source supplies short patches of twelve seconds in Bird Song and thirteen in Space [1]
- **gd1982-05-21.149237.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5M (50' from stage) [3]. Also: N. Hoey's Nakamichi 300 source supplies a seven-second patch in Drums [3]
- **gd82-05-21.sbd.gorinsky.5041.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [8]
- **gd1982-05-21.sbd.fix.miller.96330.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M) -> Dat -> CD [9]
- **gd1982-05-21.163527.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Wiseman and Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90) [10]. Also: Mark Severson's Nakamichi 700 source provides the noodling intro and first notes of CC Rider, 42 seconds in total; The same Nakamichi 700 source also patches eleven seconds in the Space into The Wheel transition [10]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Jerry Garcia: [1982-05-22 Greek Theatre, Berkeley, CA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1982-05-22-greek-theatre-berkeley-ca/) [30]
- Fan art by arizjones.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead, The Greek Theater, Berkeley, CA. Three shows May 1982 (SBD)](https://arizjones.blogspot.com/2015/01/grateful-dead-greek-theater-berkeley-ca.html) [31]
- Poster by arizjones.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead, The Greek Theater, Berkeley, CA. Three shows May 1982 (SBD)](https://arizjones.blogspot.com/2015/01/grateful-dead-greek-theater-berkeley-ca.html) [32]
